bodyText: §226. Qualification for federal programs. The department shall be qualified to participate in any federal program that renders assistance in program areas that the department is mandated by the Act to implement.
bodyHtml: §226.  Qualification for federal programs.  The department shall be qualified to participate in any federal program that renders assistance in program areas that the department is mandated by the Act to implement. [L 1978, c 204, §1]
